hero.detail: As a person, create your account with email or WhatsApp. If you have a business or a group, register it and invite your team with their roles.

sides.title: Two separate sides
sides.detail: You can use both with the same account, but each side only sees its own data.

people.title: For people
people.point1: Sign in without a password, using a code by email or WhatsApp.
people.point2: Your personal profile stays separate from your work.

business.title: For businesses
business.point1: All group companies in one place.
business.point2: Users with roles by organization and company.
business.point3: An audit trail of who did what and when.

1.title: Register your business
1.detail: With your email or WhatsApp and your organization name. You become the Owner.

2.title: Add the other companies
2.detail: All group companies in one place.

3.title: Invite your team
3.detail: Each person uses their account and the roles you assign.
